mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2D6, 3A4) reducing perphenazine metabolism, leading to increased perphenazine levels and enhanced antipsychotic/anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine side effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, anticholinergic effects); consider dose reduction or alternative H2 blocker (famotidine) if interaction is problematic.
